title: A Comprehensive Survey and Classification of Evaluation Criteria for Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing group fairness metrics (e.g., parity-based, confusion matrix-based, calibration-based, and score-based metrics) used to measure fairness and equalized opportunities across protected demographic groups such as gender and race.

Surveying evaluation techniques that measure a model's dependency on multiple sensitive attributes simultaneously, and assessing sample-robust optimization methods designed to meet fairness constraints across intersecting identities.
Highlighting specific NLP evaluation frameworks that score gender bias using Sentence Likelihood Difference (SLD) in conjunction with targeted datasets like the Triple Gender Bias dataset.

Examining methodologies that measure inequity by scoring the negative impact on minority demographics, such as assessing aggregate benefit versus inequity for minority borrowers in loan approval algorithms or analyzing racial dependencies in crime rate prediction models.

Reviewing evaluation frameworks (like Fairbench and CLEAM) that compute representation bias and assess equal representation across generated outputs in systems such as text-to-image generators, GANs, and recommender systems.
